## AuthorizationSignatureArgs interface

Signed Morpho Blue authorization payload produced when an integrator opts into offchain signatures (`supportSignature: true`<!-- -->). Consumed by the action layer to emit a `setAuthorizationWithSig` bundler call in place of a standalone `setAuthorization` transaction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface AuthorizationSignatureArgs
```
